findings.root_cause: Single-quoted payload returned verbatim as string; upstream ini parses valid inner JSON into numbers/arrays/objects.
findings.impact: A non-string registry value becomes a complete local-path declaration.
findings.fix: Reject typed inner JSON; preserve string coercion and exact upstream quote semantics.
findings.status: accepted by root; parser owner implementing

findings.reproduction: 240KiB XML containing30,000 comments; callback schedules cancel after100us.10/10 successful nonnil reports while context was canceled.
findings.root_cause: No cancellation check after Parse or before final report publication.
findings.impact: Last-file parse can return success despite an already-canceled context.
findings.fix: Check cancellation after Parse and before publishing report.
findings.status: accepted by root; parser owner implementing

findings.reproduction: Duplicate XML declaration; <?xml garbage?>; <?xml?>; XML declaration after comment.
findings.root_cause: encoding/xml does not validate this declaration grammar/placement; current check accepts every xml-target PI before root.
findings.impact: Malformed XML marked syntax complete and declaration count complete.
findings.fix: Only accept a single supported syntactically valid leading declaration; reject malformed/misplaced declarations transactionally.
findings.status: accepted by root; parser owner implementing
